title: RSPack 2.0: Performance Gains, Leaner Dependencies and ESM Core
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/07/rspack-2-release/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1783006187263.jpg"/><p>Rspack, developed by ByteDance, has released version 2.0, featuring enhanced performance, reduced dependencies, and a focus on modern ECMAScript modules. Key updates include a pure ESM core, improved static analysis, and support for RSC. Performance benchmarks show big improvements in build times. The project has experienced substantial growth, with npm downloads exceeding 5 million weekly.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
